definition.def: You use subsequent to describe something that happened or existed after the time or event that has just been referred to. [formal]
examples: ...the increase of population in subsequent years.
Those concerns were overshadowed by subsequent events.

definition.def: If something happened subsequent to something else, it happened after that thing. [formal]
examples: They won only one more game subsequent to their Cup semi-final win last year.
